feedback.problem:
What is the minor of ${d}_{32}$ in the matrix
$D=[\begin{aligned}3s & -{r}^{2} & 2t \\ -r & 0 & r \\ 5t & 4r & 1\end{aligned}]?$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we remove the third row and second column:

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}3s & ∗ & 2t \\ -r & ∗ & r \\ ∗ & 4r & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

Next, we calculate the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det[\begin{aligned}3s & 2t \\ -r & r\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}3s & 2t \\ -r & r\end{aligned}| \\  & =3s\cdot r-2t\cdot (-r) \\  & =3rs-(-2rt) \\  & =3rs+2rt\end{aligned}
$$
